FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 258
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Kyle South
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 04/28/2023
House Bill 258as introduced would exempt High Socks for Hope, Incorporated from paying
state, county and municipal sales and use taxes, which will decrease receipts to the following
funds by the following estimated annual amounts, based on information provided by the entity:
Education Trust Fund ($ 710)
County Funds ($ 880)
Municipal Funds ($ 530)
TOTAL ($2,120)
